final: WITH g AS (SELECT ma.player_id AS pid, p.bats AS bats, COUNT(*) AS c FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON CAST(p.player_id AS TEXT) = CAST(ma.player_id AS TEXT) GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.bats), h AS (SELECT bats, SUM(c) AS total FROM g GROUP BY bats), o AS (SELECT SUM(total) AS overall FROM h) SELECT h.bats, h.total, CAST(h.total AS REAL) / o.overall AS ratio FROM h JOIN o ON o.overall IS NOT NULL
